data.title: Ethereum Jumps 8% to $2,080 as Tom Lee Backs Vlad Tenev's 'Global Tokenization Supercycle'
data.description: Fundstrat’s Tom Lee says tokenization could provide a major tailwind for crypto as Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) surged 8% to $2,080 on Wednesday.Tom Lee Backs Tokenization ThesisLee called out a potential cloud breakout for the altcoin, saying it would be its first bullish trend signal since October 2025…
